Avatar: The Last Airbender isn’t just one of the greatest animated shows ever made, Theorists. It’s a story about balance, grief, friendship, redemption, and what it REALLY takes to change the world. Today, we’re breaking down the ENTIRE series to uncover what Avatar was trying to teach us all along… and why, more than 20 years later, those lessons matter more than ever.
